ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p263/r3.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p263/r3.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p263/r3.claim: Naming Hell explicitly in ‘keepers of Hell’ instead of saying ‘its keepers’ heightens dread; the damned may imagine these angels more exalted and hope they will intercede.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p263/r3.anchor: لما في ذكر جهنم من التهويل

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p263/r4.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p263/r4.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p263/r4.claim: The keepers' ‘then pray’ is either mockery or a challenge to pray themselves, since the keepers dare not make the request.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p263/r4.anchor: فادعوا أنتم على معنى الهزء بهم، أو فادعوا أنتم، فإنا لا نجترئ على ذلك

STUDYQURAN:40:intro/r8.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:40:intro/r8.speaker: author
STUDYQURAN:40:intro/r8.claim: Verses 10–20 warn of the disbelievers’ Hereafter; this sets up the extended Moses and Pharaoh account, centered on a believer in Pharaoh’s House challenging opposition to Moses.
STUDYQURAN:40:intro/r8.anchor: Vv. 10–20 then tell of the place of the disbelievers in the Hereafter

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-7-english:p12/r5.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-7-english:p12/r5.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-7-english:p12/r5.claim: The Moses–Pharaoh account warns Quraysh, encourages Muhammad and his companions to endure trials until victory, and profiles a Pharaoh’s family believer as a lesson for Quraysh and hesitant sympathizers.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-7-english:p12/r5.anchor: A specific part of the account of Moses (sws) and the Pharaoh is recounted so that a reminder can be sounded

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-7-english:p26/r2.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-7-english:p26/r2.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-7-english:p26/r2.claim: The Moses and Pharaoh story supports the prior claim that a people rejecting their messenger are destroyed despite worldly grandeur, and assures the Prophet and companions to persevere in their duty.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-7-english:p26/r2.anchor: when a messenger is sent to a nation and it denies him, then it is necessarily destroyed however much it may be superior

STUDYQURAN:40:49/r1.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:40:49/r1.speaker: author
STUDYQURAN:40:49/r1.claim: Because their worldly protectors cannot help them in the Hereafter, the denizens of Hell seek intercession from Hell’s keeper angels.
STUDYQURAN:40:49/r1.anchor: those whom they had followed and had taken as protectors in the world cannot avail them in the Hereafter

STUDYQURAN:40:49/r3.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:40:49/r3.speaker: author
STUDYQURAN:40:49/r3.claim: Their belated affirmation cannot avert or alleviate punishment, and their supplications cannot help; other passages voice the same too-late plea.
STUDYQURAN:40:49/r3.anchor: their now belated affirmation can do nothing to forestall or alleviate their punishment; nor can their supplications

STUDYQURAN:40:49/r4.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:40:49/r4.speaker: author
STUDYQURAN:40:49/r4.claim: Even if the disbelievers were sent back, they would return to what they had been forbidden.
STUDYQURAN:40:49/r4.anchor: even if they were sent back, they would return to the very thing they had been forbidden

TAB-FULL:v20p343/r1.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v20p343/r1.speaker: author
TAB-FULL:v20p343/r1.claim: The people of Hell appeal to its keepers to ask God for relief from their severe distress, hoping for a reprieve from the punishment.
TAB-FULL:v20p343/r1.anchor: وقال أهل جهنم لخزنتها وقوامها استغاثة بهم من عظيم ما هم فيه من البلاء، ورجاء أن يجدوا من عندهم فرجا

TAB-FULL:v20p343/r2.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v20p343/r2.speaker: author
TAB-FULL:v20p343/r2.claim: They ask for an amount equal to one worldly day of relief, since the afterlife has no night by which to measure a day.
TAB-FULL:v20p343/r2.anchor: وإنما قلنا: معنى ذلك: قدر يوم من أيام الدنيا، لأن الآخرة يوم لا ليل فيه

BURSEVI:v8p145#3/r4.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v8p145#3/r4.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v8p145#3/r4.claim: Those who ask the keepers include both the weak and the arrogant, after they have tasted the punishment and exhausted their options.
BURSEVI:v8p145#3/r4.anchor: جميعا ، لما ذاقوا شدة العذاب وضاقت حيلهم

BURSEVI:v8p145#3/r5.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v8p145#3/r5.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v8p145#3/r5.claim: The keepers are those who administer punishment to Hell’s inhabitants.
BURSEVI:v8p145#3/r5.anchor: القوام بتعذيب أهل النار. جمع خازن

BURSEVI:v8p145#3/r6.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v8p145#3/r6.speaker: الراغب
BURSEVI:v8p145#3/r6.claim: Al-Rāghib explains that خزن is to preserve something in a store, then by extension any kind of keeping, such as keeping a secret.
BURSEVI:v8p145#3/r6.anchor: قاله الراغب : ووضع جهنم موضع الضمير

BURSEVI:v8p145#3/r7.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v8p145#3/r7.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v8p145#3/r7.claim: Naming Jahannam instead of using a pronoun heightens dread and horror; Jahannam is the name of God’s kindled fire.
BURSEVI:v8p145#3/r7.anchor: ووضع جهنم موضع الضمير للتهويل والتفظيع.

BURSEVI:v8p145#4/r1.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v8p145#4/r1.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v8p145#4/r1.claim: They ask the keepers to intercede for them.
BURSEVI:v8p145#4/r1.anchor:
شافعين لنا.
{يخفف عنا يوما} ؛ أي : في مقدار يوم واحد

BURSEVI:v8p145#4/r2.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v8p145#4/r2.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v8p145#4/r2.claim: They ask for some reduction in punishment for the span of one earthly day.
BURSEVI:v8p145#4/r2.anchor: في مقدار يوم واحد من أيام الدنيا.

BURSEVI:v8p145#4/r3.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v8p145#4/r3.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v8p145#4/r3.claim: يوما is an adverb of duration for يخفف; its object is omitted, with من العذاب explaining that omitted object.
BURSEVI:v8p145#4/r3.anchor:
مفعوله محذوف.
ومن العذاب بيان لذلك المحذوف

BURSEVI:v8p145#4/r4.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v8p145#4/r4.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v8p145#4/r4.claim: They request only slight relief for a short time, rather than no punishment or a greater reduction for longer, because they know those larger requests are impossible.
BURSEVI:v8p145#4/r4.anchor: واقتصارهم في الاستدعاء على تخفيف قدر يسير من العذاب في مقدار قصير من الزمان دون رفعه رأسا

TABATABAI:40:48-49/r5.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:40:48-49/r5.speaker: author
TABATABAI:40:48-49/r5.claim: Those in the Fire ask its keepers to pray because they despair of their own prayers being answered.
TABATABAI:40:48-49/r5.anchor: وهم إنما سألوا الخزنة أن يدعوا لهم ليأسهم من أن يستجاب منهم أنفسهم

TABATABAI:40:48-49/r6.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:40:48-49/r6.speaker: author
TABATABAI:40:48-49/r6.claim: “A day” of punishment means a portion of punishment, with day understood according to the nature of their realm.
TABATABAI:40:48-49/r6.anchor: والمراد باليوم من العذاب ما يناسب من معنى اليوم لعالمهم الذي هم فيه

TABRISI:40:50/r8.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:40:50/r8.speaker: author
TABRISI:40:50/r8.claim: The guards of Hell are the angels assigned to administer punishment to its inhabitants.
TABRISI:40:50/r8.anchor: وهم الذين يتولون عذاب أهل النار من الملائكة الموكلين بهم

TABRISI:40:50/r9.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:40:50/r9.speaker: author
TABRISI:40:50/r9.claim: Unable to endure severe torment, they beg for one day's relief, still hoping despite knowing by necessary knowledge that punishment never ends or lessens.
TABRISI:40:50/r9.anchor: يقولون ذلك لأنه لا طاقة لهم على شدة العذاب ولشدة جزعهم

WAHIDI-WAJIZ:40:49-51/r1.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:40:49-51/r1.speaker: author
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:40:49-51/r1.claim: The people in the Fire plead with Hell's keepers to ask God to lessen their punishment for one day.
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:40:49-51/r1.anchor: وقال الذين في النار لخزنة جهنم ادعوا ربكم يخفف عنا يوما

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:40:47/r2.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:40:47/r2.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:40:47/r2.claim: Those who followed the powerful instead of freely choosing their beliefs and actions are cast into Hell with them and ask the leaders to remove even part of the fire; the leaders know they can save no one, and the requesters likely know this too, so the question exposes their helplessness (Razi).
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:40:47/r2.anchor: Bu ikincilerden, dünyadayken inanç ve eylemlerini kendi özgür iradeleriyle seçmek yerine, baskıcı kesimin talepleri istikametinde hareket edenler, bu tutumları sebebiyle âhirette diğerleriyle birlikte cehenneme atılınca

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:40:47/r3.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:40:47/r3.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:40:47/r3.claim: For true freedom and salvation, people must choose beliefs and conduct freely rather than become followers of wealthy, influential, immoral deniers; once God judges, no one can rescue another, and even angels refuse their pleas.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:40:47/r3.anchor: İnsanlar, hasbelkader yüksek bir ekonomik güç, toplumsal ve siyasî statü elde etmiş olan inkârcı ve erdemsiz kesimlerin, baskın grupların uydusu olmak yerine, kendilerini Allah karşısında sorumlu duruma düşürecek inanç ve davranış konularında özgür bireyler olarak seçimlerini hür iradeleriyle kendileri yapmalıdırlar

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:40:47/r4.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:40:47/r4.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:40:47/r4.claim: People must seek salvation before Judgment Day, when no one can help except by God’s will; in this life they should resist inner desires and dominant misleaders, heed God’s messenger and clear truths, and follow his pure way of life.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:40:47/r4.anchor: İnsan kendi kurtuluşunu arama görevini kıyamet gününe bırakmamalıdır; çünkü o zaman Allah’ın dilemesi dışında kimse kimseye yardımcı olamayacaktır. Şu halde insan, kurtuluş çarelerini dünyada aramalı

BURHAN:v2p490/r2.author: al-Zarkashī
BURHAN:v2p490/r2.speaker: author
BURHAN:v2p490/r2.claim: Repeating the explicit name can cultivate awe in the hearer, like invoking the Caliph's authority; the people in Hell address the keepers of Hell by its name.
BURHAN:v2p490/r2.anchor: السادس أن يكون القصد تربية المهابة وإدخال الروعة في ضمير السامع بذكر الاسم

DAMGHANI:v1p157/r16.author: al-Dāmghānī
DAMGHANI:v1p157/r16.speaker: author
DAMGHANI:v1p157/r16.claim: Takhfīf can mean reducing punishment, here a request to ease one day of torment.
DAMGHANI:v1p157/r16.anchor: الرابع : التخفيف نقصان العذاب قوله تعالى في سورة حم المؤمن

DAMGHANI:v1p173/r5.author: al-Dāmghānī
DAMGHANI:v1p173/r5.speaker: author
DAMGHANI:v1p173/r5.claim: Duʿāʾ can mean asking or petitioning; the people in the Fire ask its keepers to petition their Lord.
DAMGHANI:v1p173/r5.anchor: السادس : ادع ربك بمعنى سل كقوله تعالى في سورة الأعراف

NAHHAS:v4p36/r4.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v4p36/r4.speaker: author
NAHHAS:v4p36/r4.claim: الذين is either built like its singular or declined as اللذون; Sa'id al-Akhfash explains its nūn as attached to الذي like خمسة عشر.
NAHHAS:v4p36/r4.anchor: ومن العرب من يقول اللذون على أنه جمع مسلم معرب

NAHHAS:v4p36/r5.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v4p36/r5.speaker: author
NAHHAS:v4p36/r5.claim: خزنة is plural of خازن; خزان and خزن are also forms.
NAHHAS:v4p36/r5.anchor: وخزنة جمع خازن ويقال خزان وخزن

NAHHAS:v4p36/r6.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v4p36/r6.speaker: author
NAHHAS:v4p36/r6.claim: يخفف is jussive as an imperative response without fāʾ; with fāʾ it is subjunctive, and Arabic commonly omits fāʾ after commands.
NAHHAS:v4p36/r6.anchor: ( أدعوا ربكم يخفف ) جواب مجزوم وإذا كان بالفاء كان منصوبا

NAHHAS:v4p36/r7.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v4p36/r7.speaker: author
NAHHAS:v4p36/r7.claim: The line قفا نبك from Imru al-Qays illustrates the command-response construction.
NAHHAS:v4p36/r7.anchor: على هذا جاء القرآن بأفصح اللغات كما قال ( قفا نبك من ذكرى حبيب ومنزل )

NAHHAS:v4p36/r8.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v4p36/r8.speaker: أبو الدرداء
NAHHAS:v4p36/r8.claim: Abu al-Darda reports Hell's people suffer hunger, choking food, and scalding drink, then ask angels for relief; the angels tell them to pray, but the plea is futile.
NAHHAS:v4p36/r8.anchor: وفي الحديث عن أبي الدرداء قال يلقى على أهل النار الجوع

SAMIN-DURR:40:49/r1.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:40:49/r1.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:40:49/r1.claim: One parse makes يوما an adverb of يخفف with its object omitted; on al-Akhfash's view من is extra and العذاب is the object, so relief is on a day of punishment.
SAMIN-DURR:40:49/r1.anchor: أحدهما: أنه ظرف ل " يخفف ". ومفعول " يخفف " محذوف

SAMIN-DURR:40:49/r2.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:40:49/r2.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:40:49/r2.claim: A second parse makes يوما the object, understood as the punishment contained in a day; this is strained with من العذاب, and treating the phrase as an emphatic adjective is even weaker.
SAMIN-DURR:40:49/r2.anchor: الثاني: أن يكون مفعولا به، واليوم لا يخفف، وإنما يخفف مظروفه فالتقدير: يخفف عذاب يوم.

SAMIN-DURR:40:49/r3.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:40:49/r3.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:40:49/r3.claim: The apparent parse makes من العذاب the object of يخفف, with من partitive and يوما an adverb: they ask for some punishment to be eased for some day, not all punishment, every day, or one specified day.
SAMIN-DURR:40:49/r3.anchor: والظاهر أن " من العذاب " هو المفعول ل " يخفف " ، و " من " تبعيضية،

ASAD-NOTES:40:49#n33/r1.author: Muhammad Asad
ASAD-NOTES:40:49#n33/r1.speaker: author
ASAD-NOTES:40:49#n33/r1.claim: The keepers are angelic forces watching over sinners' suffering in the hereafter; Asad suggests they may allegorize the belated awakening of sinners' conscience.
ASAD-NOTES:40:49#n33/r1.anchor: perhaps an allegory of the belated awakening of the latters' conscience.

NASHR:v2p72/r4.author: Ibn al-Jazarī
NASHR:v2p72/r4.speaker: author
NASHR:v2p72/r4.claim: The author analogically gives preference to imāla in this phrase for those who otherwise take fatḥ, because assimilation leaves a kasra after the alif.
NASHR:v2p72/r4.anchor: وقد تترجح الإمالة عند من يأخذ بالفتح من قوله في النار لخزنة جهنم

ALUSI-FULL:v24p75#2/r1.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v24p75#2/r1.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v24p75#2/r1.claim: Both the weak and the arrogant inhabitants of the Fire make this request when their arguments fail and their options narrow.
ALUSI-FULL:v24p75#2/r1.anchor: من الضعفاء والمستكبرين جميعا لما ضاقت بهم الحيل وعيت بهم العلل

ALUSI-FULL:v24p75#2/r2.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v24p75#2/r2.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v24p75#2/r2.claim: Naming the keepers of Jahannam rather than the keepers of the Fire intensifies the threat, since Jahannam is more specific and may denote the deepest pit.
ALUSI-FULL:v24p75#2/r2.anchor: وكان الظاهر لخزنتها بضمير النار لكن وضع الظاهر موضعه للتهويل فإن جهنم أخص من النار

ALUSI-FULL:v24p75#2/r3.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v24p75#2/r3.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v24p75#2/r3.claim: Another explanation places these disbelievers in Jahannam, the deepest level, and supposes its angels most likely to answer because of their greater nearness to God.
ALUSI-FULL:v24p75#2/r3.anchor: أو لأنها محل لأشد العذاب الشامل للنار وغيرها وجوز أن يكون ذلك لبيان محل الكفرة في النار بأن تكون جهنم أبعد دركاتها

ALUSI-FULL:v24p75#2/r4.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v24p75#2/r4.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v24p75#2/r4.claim: A further explanation is that those angels are assigned to the worst inmates and are presumed more responsive because of their closeness to God.
ALUSI-FULL:v24p75#2/r4.anchor: فلعل الملائكة الموكلين بعذاب أولئك أجوب دعوة لزيادة قربهم من الله عز وجل

ALUSI-FULL:v24p75#2/r5.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v24p75#2/r5.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v24p75#2/r5.claim: They ask that one day’s measure, reckoned by worldly days, be removed from the punishment.
ALUSI-FULL:v24p75#2/r5.anchor: أي مقدار يوم من أيام الدنيا

ALUSI-FULL:v24p75#2/r6.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v24p75#2/r6.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v24p75#2/r6.claim: Min can be explanatory or partitive; one parse omits the object of lighten and treats min al-ʿadhāb as its clarification.
ALUSI-FULL:v24p75#2/r6.anchor: فمفعول ( يخفف ) محذوف و ( من ) تمل البيان والتبعيض

ALUSI-FULL:v24p75#2/r7.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v24p75#2/r7.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v24p75#2/r7.claim: Alternatively, day is the object with an omitted noun such as torment of a day, and from the punishment explains it: they ask to be spared one day of punishment.

BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p151#2/r2.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p151#2/r2.speaker: author
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p151#2/r2.claim: The people of the Fire make their plea when the punishment has intensified against them.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p151#2/r2.anchor: في النار} حين اشتد عليهم العذاب

BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p151#2/r3.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p151#2/r3.speaker: author
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p151#2/r3.claim: They ask the keepers of Hell to appeal to God to reduce their punishment for one day.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p151#2/r3.anchor: لخزنة جهنم ادعوا ربكم يخفف عنا يوما من العذاب

BAYDAWI-FULL:40:47-49/r10.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:40:47-49/r10.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:40:47-49/r10.claim: The explicit name Jahannam replaces a pronoun either to intensify dread or to identify their location in it, perhaps its deepest level.

BAYDAWI-FULL:40:47-49/r11.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:40:47-49/r11.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:40:47-49/r11.claim: The requested day may mean an amount of time, with some of the punishment specifying it; alternatively, day is the object with an omitted genitive.
BAYDAWI-FULL:40:47-49/r11.anchor: قدر يوم. { من العذاب } شيئا من العذاب

BIQAI-FULL:v6p522/r2.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v6p522/r2.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v6p522/r2.claim: Seeing their distance from God and unfitness to address Him, Hell's inhabitants turn their hopes to the angels as intermediaries.

BIQAI-FULL:v6p522/r3.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v6p522/r3.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v6p522/r3.claim: Those asking the guardians include all the people in Hell, both followers and those followed.

BIQAI-FULL:v6p522/r4.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v6p522/r4.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v6p522/r4.claim: Naming Hell instead of using a pronoun evokes its layer and grimacing guardians, showing the damned's misery and inability to put things in their proper place, as in worldly life.
BIQAI-FULL:v6p522/r4.anchor: للدلالة على أن سؤالهم لأهل الطبقة

BIQAI-FULL:v6p522/r5.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v6p522/r5.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v6p522/r5.claim: They ask for one day's worth of relief from only part of the punishment.
BIQAI-FULL:v6p522/r5.anchor: يخفف عنه يوما } أي مقداره { من العذاب

IBNASHUR-FULL:v24p159#2/r8.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v24p159#2/r8.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v24p159#2/r8.claim: On the second analysis, the pronoun refers to the people of Hell generally, not Pharaoh’s family: the following scene mentions their guardians and plural messengers, while Pharaoh had only Moses.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v24p159#2/r8.anchor: وضمير { يتحاجون } غير عائد إلى { ءال فرعون } ( غافر : 46 ) لأن ذلك يأباه قوله : { وقال الذين في النار

IBNASHUR-FULL:v24p164/r1.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v24p164/r1.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v24p164/r1.claim: Khazana is the plural of khāzin, a keeper of what a place contains, such as property or goods.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v24p164/r1.anchor: وخزنة : جمع خازن ، وهو الحافظ لما في المكان من مال أو عروض

IBNASHUR-FULL:v24p164/r2.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v24p164/r2.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v24p164/r2.claim: The keepers are angels assigned to Hell, its fire and fuel, its punished inhabitants, and the management of its affairs.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v24p164/r2.anchor: هم الملائكة الموكلون بما تحويه من النار ووقودها والمعذبين فيها وموكلون بتسيير ما تحتوي عليه دار العذاب

IBNASHUR-FULL:v24p164/r3.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v24p164/r3.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v24p164/r3.claim: The explicit Jahannam is not a noun repeated in place of a pronoun: the keepers guard what Hell contains, not the fire itself; 67:6–8 accordingly uses a pronoun for Jahannam.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v24p164/r3.anchor: فليس قوله هنا : { جهنم } إظهارا في مقام الإضمار إذ لا يحسن إضافة خزنة إلى النار

IBNASHUR-FULL:v24p164/r4.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v24p164/r4.speaker: الزمخشري
IBNASHUR-FULL:v24p164/r4.claim: Al-Zamakhshari in al-Kashshaf takes the explicit Jahannam as a substitution for a pronoun intended to intensify the threat.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v24p164/r4.anchor: وفي ( الكشاف ) أنه من الإظهار في مقام الإضمار للتهويل بلفظ { جهنم }

IBNASHUR-FULL:v24p164/r5.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v24p164/r5.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v24p164/r5.claim: Ibn ʿAshur says his account of the construction is clearer than al-Zamakhshari’s.

IBNASHUR-FULL:v24p164/r6.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v24p164/r6.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v24p164/r6.claim: Calling God their Lord encourages the inmates to pray, since they think the guardians are more likely to be answered; they ask for one day of relief, more useful than reduced fire intensity.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v24p164/r6.anchor: وفي إضافة ( رب ) إلى ضمير المخاطبين ضرب من الإغراء بالدعاء ، أي لأنكم أقرب إلى استجابته لكم

IBNASHUR-FULL:v24p164/r7.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v24p164/r7.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v24p164/r7.claim: The jussive after the command may reflect an omitted lām of command, a frequent construction.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v24p164/r7.anchor: وجزم { يخفف } بعد الأمر بالدعاء ، ولعله بتقدير لام الأمر لكثرة الاستعمال

IBNASHUR-FULL:v24p164/r8.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v24p164/r8.speaker: من أهل العربية
IBNASHUR-FULL:v24p164/r8.claim: Some grammarians treat the jussive as the result of the request, expressing a causal connection; this signals the inmates’ confidence that the guardians’ prayers will be answered.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v24p164/r8.anchor: ومن أهل العربية من يجعله جزما في جواب الطلب لتحقيق التسبب . فيكون فيه إيذان بأن الذين في النار واثقون

IBNASHUR-FULL:v24p164/r9.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v24p164/r9.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v24p164/r9.claim: The jussive is common after a command to say and similar requests; Ibn ʿAshur discussed the construction at 14:31.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v24p164/r9.anchor: وهذا الجزم شائع بعد الأمر بالقول وما في معناه لهذه النكتة وحقه الرفع أو إظهار لام الأمر

IBNASHUR-FULL:v24p164/r10.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v24p164/r10.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v24p164/r10.claim: Yukhafif may include the sense of ينقص and take يوم as its direct object, or an omitted عذاب may be understood, meaning the amount of a day.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v24p164/r10.anchor: وضمن { يخفف } معنى ينقص فنصب { يوما

IBNASHUR-FULL:v24p164/r11.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v24p164/r11.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v24p164/r11.claim: Day figuratively means a little time; من العذاب explains يوم, understood as an amount, though it may also attach directly to يخفف.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v24p164/r11.anchor: واليوم كناية عن القلة ، أي يخفف عنا ولو زمنا قليلا . و { من العذاب } بيان ل { يوما }

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p563/r10.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p563/r10.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p563/r10.claim: All the people in the Fire ask its keepers to pray for a reduction equal to one worldly day of punishment.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p563/r10.anchor: ثم قال جميع من في النار لخزنتها وزبانيتها: ادعوا ربكم عسى أن يخفف عنا مقدار يوم من أيام الدنيا

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p230#2/r1.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p230#2/r1.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p230#2/r1.claim: The keepers answer that they themselves will not pray for the people in Hell; they must call upon God.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p230#2/r1.anchor: ومعنى قول الخزنة لهم ﴿ فادعوا ﴾ أي نحن لا ندعو لكم

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p230#2/r2.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p230#2/r2.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p230#2/r2.claim: The disbelievers' prayer is futile and brings no benefit.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p230#2/r2.anchor: ﴿ وما دعاء الكافرين إلا في ضلال ﴾ أي إن ذلك يبطل ولا ينفع

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p149/r2.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p149/r2.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p149/r2.claim: Despairing that God will accept or hear them after His command to be despised in Hell and remain silent, the inmates ask the keepers, like doorkeepers, to seek one day's respite.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p149/r2.anchor: لما علموا أن الله، سبحانه، لا يستجيب منهم ولا يستمع لدعائهم

MUQATIL:40:48-50/r2.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:40:48-50/r2.speaker: author
MUQATIL:40:48-50/r2.claim: When the people in Hell feel the severity of punishment, they ask its keepers to request that God lessen it for one day.
MUQATIL:40:48-50/r2.anchor: { وقال الذين فى النار } فلما ذاق أهل النار شدة العذاب، قالوا: { لخزنة جهنم ادعوا ربكم } يعنى سلوا لنا ربكم { يخفف عنا يوما }

MUQATIL:40:48-50/r3.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:40:48-50/r3.speaker: author
MUQATIL:40:48-50/r3.claim: The phrase one day has an omitted phrase understood as one day from the days of this world.
MUQATIL:40:48-50/r3.anchor: { يخفف عنا يوما } من أيام الدنيا إضمار { من العذاب }

NASAFI-FULL:v4p77#2/r1.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v4p77#2/r1.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v4p77#2/r1.claim: The keepers are attendants charged with tormenting Hell's inhabitants; naming Hell rather than simply its keepers intensifies the dread.
NASAFI-FULL:v4p77#2/r1.anchor: للقوام بتعذيب اهلها وانما لم يقل لخزنتها لان في ذكر جهنم تهويلا وتفظيعا

NASAFI-FULL:v4p77#2/r2.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v4p77#2/r2.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v4p77#2/r2.claim: Jahannam may be the deepest pit, as in the expression “a deep well”; its angels may be more likely to answer because they are especially close to Allah, so the inmates address them.
NASAFI-FULL:v4p77#2/r2.anchor: ويحتمل ان جهنم هى ابعد النار قعرا من قولهم بئر جهنام بعيدة القعر وفيها اعتى الكفار واطغاهم فلعل الملائكة الموكلين بعذاب اولئك اجوب دعوة

NASAFI-FULL:v4p77#2/r3.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v4p77#2/r3.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v4p77#2/r3.claim: They ask for relief from the punishment for the measure of one worldly day.
NASAFI-FULL:v4p77#2/r3.anchor: يخفف عنا يوما ﴾ بقدر يوم من الدنيا

QURTUBI-FULL:40:47-49/r11.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:40:47-49/r11.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:40:47-49/r11.claim: The people asking for relief are the nations of unbelievers in the Fire.
QURTUBI-FULL:40:47-49/r11.anchor: الذين في النار } من الأمم الكافرة

QURTUBI-FULL:40:47-49/r12.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:40:47-49/r12.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:40:47-49/r12.claim: Some Arabs use alladhūn as an inflected sound masculine plural; others retain the indeclinability of alladhī in the nominative.
QURTUBI-FULL:40:47-49/r12.anchor: ومن العرب من يقول اللذون على أنه جمع مسلم معرب

QURTUBI-FULL:40:47-49/r13.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:40:47-49/r13.speaker: الأخفش
QURTUBI-FULL:40:47-49/r13.claim: Al-Akhfash says the nūn was joined to alladhī, making it resemble the indeclinable number khamsata ʿashar.
QURTUBI-FULL:40:47-49/r13.anchor: وقال الأخفش: ضمت النون إلى الذي فأشبه خمسة عشر

QURTUBI-FULL:40:47-49/r14.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:40:47-49/r14.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:40:47-49/r14.claim: Khazana is the plural of khāzin; alternative plural forms are khuzzān and khazan.
QURTUBI-FULL:40:47-49/r14.anchor: خزنة جمع خازن ويقال: خزان وخزن

QURTUBI-FULL:40:47-49/r15.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:40:47-49/r15.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:40:47-49/r15.claim: Yukhaffif is jussive as response to the imperative; with fa it would be subjunctive, but Arabic usually omits fa in such responses.
QURTUBI-FULL:40:47-49/r15.anchor: «يخفف» جواب مجزوم وإن كان بالفاء كان منصوبا

QURTUBI-FULL:40:47-49/r16.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:40:47-49/r16.speaker: الشاعر
QURTUBI-FULL:40:47-49/r16.claim: The line qifā nabki illustrates an imperative response without fa, the construction described as eloquent Arabic.
QURTUBI-FULL:40:47-49/r16.anchor: كما قال: قفا نبك من ذكرى حبيب ومنزل

QURTUBI-FULL:40:47-49/r17.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:40:47-49/r17.speaker: محمد بن كعب القرظي
QURTUBI-FULL:40:47-49/r17.claim: Al-Qurazi says he was told the people of Hell begged its keepers for a day's relief; the keepers answered that messengers had brought proofs and told them to pray, but unbelievers' prayers are futile.
QURTUBI-FULL:40:47-49/r17.anchor: قال محمد بن كعب القرظي: بلغني أو ذكر لي أن أهل النار استغاثوا بالخزنة

QURTUBI-FULL:40:47-49/r18.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:40:47-49/r18.speaker: أبو الدرداء
QURTUBI-FULL:40:47-49/r18.claim: A report from Abu al-Darda, cited by al-Tirmidhi and others, describes hunger, unsatisfying thorny food, choking food, boiling drink that scalds faces and cuts bowels, then the inmates' futile plea to angels.
QURTUBI-FULL:40:47-49/r18.anchor: وفي الحديث عن أبي الدرداء خرجه الترمذي وغيره قال: يلقى على أهل النار الجوع
